openings.claim: Build a manifest-aligned digest ledger that reports the earliest supported unequal stage boundary, or an unresolved interval between supported equal and unequal boundaries.
openings.delta: Change the ordering dependency from local timestamps to manifest stage order and record identifiers. A script creates matched boundary rows; manual review prioritizes claim-supporting records and gaps, logging at most twelve inspections per pair. Blank warnings and absent records remain unknown. Each result includes record references and a next check available within the remaining inspection budget.
openings.prediction: Against the nearest rival, chronological first-mismatch review, the ledger may retain a supported interval when timestamps invert or transform evidence disappears; the rival may nominate an unsupported earliest stage. Accuracy superiority is uncertain.
openings.probe: Run the two variants on the disjoint three-pair subsets within sixty minutes; freeze all six reports before opening answer sheets. Use the additional twenty minutes to compare supported boundary accuracy, unresolved intervals, references and inspection counts. Remove the stipulated transform records during final review and update affected claims without exceeding twelve inspections. Disjoint subsets confound direct performance comparison.
assumptions: Manifest identifiers permit artifact-boundary matching; ambiguous matches remain unresolved.
A definite stage requires a cited mismatch and comparable equal earlier boundaries. If earlier evidence is missing, report an interval, with an open lower end if necessary.
Defeat conditions include unmatched identifiers or exhausted inspection capacity: retain uncertainty rather than assert a stage.

openings.claim: Can a recorded export input digest identify the missing transform output boundary?
openings.delta: Change the evidence carrier from transform output to downstream input only when dictionary definitions and supplied records establish the same artifact boundary; otherwise retain the unresolved interval.
openings.prediction: The nearest rival leaves every missing transform output unresolved. A validated downstream carrier could distinguish pre-export inequality from an export-only mismatch; equality would narrow evidence without proving hidden stages identical.
openings.probe: Within the same inspection cap, inspect the dictionary and relevant export inputs for the two affected pairs. Defeat the substitution if an intervening operation, ambiguous boundary or absent input prevents equivalence.
assumptions: Boundary equivalence is unprovided; no new records or access are assumed.

assessment: Probe only; preserve distinctions between recorded inequality, missing evidence and causal explanation. Sealed answers cannot become report evidence.
